name: vibecode-db
description: Unified front-end DB API with pluggable adapters (Runtime, Supabase, ...).

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n client,core,web,expo,todo -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @vibecode-db/client" "npm run dev -w @vibecode-db/sqlite-core" "npm run dev -w @vibecode-db/sqlite-web" "npm run dev -w @vibecode-db/sqlite-expo" "npm run dev -w vibecode-todo"
scripts.dev:packages: concurrently -n client,core,web,expo -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @vibecode-db/client" "npm run dev -w @vibecode-db/sqlite-core" "npm run dev -w @vibecode-db/sqlite-web" "npm run dev -w @vibecode-db/sqlite-expo"
